# Model workflow state: visual walkthrough

Offline rules simulation, not a commercial AI platform.

1. Open this module in Scholarion and select Visual workflow lab.
2. Set review threshold to 0.8.
3. Keep missing input routed to Needs data.
4. Run the synthetic cases. No external action executes.
5. Compare with your task: Draw intake, validation, review, approval and closed states.
6. Try 0.6 and export results.
7. Record the changed decisions and human checkpoint.

Platform-specific licensed builds and screenshots remain pending.
